notes.title: Version 1.8.0.0
notes.content:
Update to latest version

Dim exit indicators if challenge level has been completed
Hunters now spawn in over time
Fade in lighting as level starts
Updated the settings menu plus new checkboxes
Added some new accessibility options
Indicate when an Archangel is about to spawn in to the level pluse new indicator
Archangels use glitches
Nerfed Jophiel homing missile damage slightly
Some new explosion SFX
Modified Hunter progress basrs on HUD to show values more clearly
Some slight changes to angel bullet sprites
Allow player to auto resume on death
Allow player to choose not display angel select menu on death
Score boost for 'hardcore' mode

notes.title: Version 1.7.2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Allow gamepad configuration to be cancelled via gamepad
[*] New 'Hunters' activated SFX
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7.1.0
notes.content:
[b]UI Refresh[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased text sizes throughout (still some items to address though)
[*] Redesign of App Progress, Angel Progress and Credits menus
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]  Made the Hunters app easier to activate once unlocked
[*]  Assault and Inferno challenges have 'versions' that get slightly more difficult
[*]  Show the version info on Challenge App Menus
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]  Time rewind and player secondary glitch SFX now respect volume settings
[*]  Attempted to fix rare occasions where game music was not respecting volume settings
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.7.0.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Assault app has 2 version: standard / expert (with infected glitches)
[*] Inferno app has 2 versions: standard / expert (with renegade golem)
[*] Score mulitpliers applied to expert app versions
[*] Updated App menus to better show progress / versions completed
[*] Updated App Progress menu to better show progress / versions completed
[*] App menus to use a new setting to toggle them on/off (so all players can see the new menus)
[*] Consistent rules for challenge apps - If a player is hit the challenge is deemed to be failed and the exit opens
[*] Collect a set number of coins on Goldrush
[*] Crates will no longer spawn coins on Goldrush and spwan gems instead
[*] Assault enemies leave splats when killed
[*] Inferno enemies leave blood splats and sparking ashes
[*] Coloured steam in challenge levels
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.6.1.0
notes.content: Fixed checkpoint button wrapping on Choose Level screen

notes.title: Glitchangels version 1.6 Released
notes.content:
Fixed: Crash bug when boss turret destroyed by cherubs while player is dead
Fixed: Arial BOOM bullet moving when game is paused
Fixed: Don't drain rage on gamepad if shoot direction not pressed
Allow tutorial to be played at any time
Do not force new players to play tutorial
Better controller hints when playing tutorial
Reduced draw call counts to increase performance
Camera remains following player when deploying decoy
Optional controller vibration
Fixed red alert / power down transitions when rewinding time
Player become immune as soon as boss is killed
Timeout powerup attracted towards player
Added valid button / trigger / stick prompts when player is configuring gamepad

notes.title: Version 1.4.1.0
notes.content:
[h3]Some subtle gameplay tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] SKULLBOY and SENTINEL shouldn't generate fire trails
[*] Reduce SENTINEL recharge value so they regain less health
[*] Stop level generator from carving islands
[*] Stop PINK THUGS from reflecting bullets when spawning from crates
[*] Inversely scale "Dragon Breath" when player fire rate is buffed
[*] Skip "Burning Bullets" glitch if player is struggling (low timeouts) or level too high
[*] Made GOLEM bullets more subtle to match cherub bullets
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.content:
[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
Slightly reduce the [i]Turret App[/i] bullet speed for levels 1-10
Show Hunter activation timer and progress on 'App Bar'
Buffed Hunter enemy score value - base score is 500 and increases by 500 each stage (1-10: 500, 11-20: 1000, etc)

[h3][b]Accessibility[/b][/h3]
Added distortion and screen shake slider options in settings.

[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
'New Glitch' marker was not showing on Main Menu when a new glitch was unlocked

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
* 16 new glitches to unlock
* Steam rises from vents / grills
* Little blue pod enemies have a short immune phase when spawned from their carrier
* Little blue pod enemies drop coins when killed
* Show blast area indicator for boom crates
* Crates will not spawn stuff if an enemy destroys them by walking into them

UI
* Toggle in the settings menu to hide App menus when beginning an app level

[b]Baiters[/b]
* Temples can be various sizes
* Randomly remove some pillars
* Add lava tiles when app is complete
* Massive 5x score multiplier to killed baiters when app is complete
* Tweeked current baiter rank progression indicator
* Add extra weapons to baiters when app is complete

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
* Performing a dodge should not launch the plasma grenade
* Cherubs will not target invincible enemies

notes.title: Version 1.2.4.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] More freedom in shop when navigation (wrap top to bottom, left to right)
[*] Only show "Collect" hint on level 2 (not when looping)
[*] 'Trojans' should stop firing when affected by ZEN_AURA
[*] 'Thugs' should not reflect bullets when affected by ZEN_AURA
[*] Blue 'Pod' enemies do not drop skulls
[*] Ensure random timeout powerups do not count towards resume cost
[*] Added resume timeout cost to HUD
[*] Save COURAGE when saving checkpoints
[*] Save angel being played when saving checkpoints to alow resumptions with same angel
[*] Glitches respect the amount of PROTECTION remaining when starting / finishing
[*] Create a checkpoint at start of Loop 2 (AKA level 51)
[*] Added loop value to HUD next to level (e.g. 12.2)
[*] Added SACRIFICE to checkpoints
[*] Show angel, CHERUBS, SACRIFICE and GOLEMS on resume chekpoint menu
[*] Some boss 'randomisaton' when looping
[*] Hopefully stopped player weapons sounds from not playing
[*] Added some extra names to the credits - THANK YOU BOTH SO MUCH FOR THE HELP
[*] Reduce the unlock delay for level and boss achievments (now unlocks when exiting level)
[*] Hide locked angel names on angel selection screen
[*] Increase cost of SACRIFICE after each purchase
[*] Apply a cost penalty on SACRIFICE when looping (AKA levels > 50)
[*] _Slightly_ increased cost of PROTECTION and GOLEM_LIFE
[*] Increased dame dealt to enemies when player has MIDAS_TOUCH
[/list]

notes.title: Glitchanges version 1.1 released
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
Disable some of the 'nerf' glitches on the much harder levels (GLOOM, etc)
Reduced glitch reward target value - rewards are now more regular
Support for more mouse buttons (left, right, middle X1, X2)
Destroy boss bullets when boss is destroyed
Made archangels a bit easier to defeat
Reduce archangel unlock kill threshold from 10 to 1 (ONE!)
New SIDEWINDER weapon for Ariel
Increase CHERUB shot frequencies
Slightly increased Gabriel's DASH glitch
Reduce mine blast radius
Sniper targeting SFX
Buffed Chamuel's SHOCKWAVE glitch to be bigger and longer lasting
Added extra pellet to Chamuel's shotgun
Audio and visual tweaks when destroying monitors
Gradually increase enemy bullet speed and movement over time
Reduce cost of initial bullet speed / damage
Temporarily removed signup flow on Linux / Max
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Handle 'lost input' when attempting secondary glitch when resuming timeout
[*]Stop playing persistent SFX (lightning, rewind, etc) when pausing
[*]Stop repeated angel unlock notification
[/list]
 
[b]Accessibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Option to turn off screen flashes in settings
[/list]
